Odense is a Danish municipality evaluated in the Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark) for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023 [^src1]. The report, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP), assesses the quality of treatment for patients with atrial fibrillation, focusing heavily on anticoagulation therapy and its safety monitoring [^src1]. 

In the context of Indicator 4b, which measures adherence to safety practices when using DOAC medications, Odense meets the standard with a compliance rate of 96.3% (2,636 out of 2,737 patients) [^src1]. This performance is marked as "Yes" (Ja) and represents the highest proportion among all larger municipalities featured in the report [^src1]. 

The report provides detailed breakdowns for all 98 Danish municipalities to support local quality development and benchmarking across the healthcare system [^src2]. For other metrics tracked in the document—such as early initiation of anticoagulation treatment (Indicator 1) or the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation (Indicator 5)—Odense records figures of 0.2% (6 out of 3,820) and 0.5% (19 out of 3,758), respectively [^src2]. These granular municipal data points underscore the decentralized responsibility for clinical quality improvement within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
